turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1 / ((1+exp[b2-b3*x])**(1/b4)) to the data in rat43.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 100, b2 = 10, b3 = 1, b4 = 1. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3, b4) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Rat43 (public domain), data copied verbatim
